- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.5) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.5), model underestimates; adjust downward by 3–7% to avoid missing downside momentum.
- Model consistently overreacts to short-term spikes; apply a 1–2 day lag correction to prevent overshoot after price surges.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–5% to align with historical volatility.
- For 30-day horizon, model often overpredicts late-period values; cap forecast at 10% below 30-day moving average of true outcomes.
- If sentiment shows sharp reversal (e.g., from +1.2 to -0.8), reduce forecast slope by 30–50% to reflect sentiment shift.
